decisionSummary: The Aug. 20 v33 dev-publish tip is the newest valid forward BotMother source. It retains the prelaunch rendering and least-privilege hardening, repairs the governed package input to use the canonical .sandstorm file list, and binds package creation to that list. Main and the recent greenfield/prelaunch branches are reviewed ancestors. The divergent codex, planning, preserved, publish, and salvage refs are historic release, documentation, or superseded work rather than a newer valid application source.
